coded.code: var __sb = {app}.SAPReadStatusbar(readStatusbarOptions: new SAPReadStatusbarOptions { Timeout = {Timeout:-30}, DelayAfter = {DelayAfter:-0.3}, DelayBefore = {DelayBefore:-0.2}, HealingAgentBehavior = UiPath.UIAutomationNext.Enums.NChildHealingAgentBehavior.{HealingAgentBehavior:-SameAsCard} }); {MessageType} = __sb.MessageType; {MessageText} = __sb.MessageText; {MessageId} = __sb.MessageId; {MessageNumber} = __sb.MessageNumber; {MessageData} = __sb.MessageData;

notes: 戻り値 SAPReadStatusbarResult の5つの項目を out に写す（5つとも IR に要る。IR に無いオプションは Studio の既定 30 / 0.3 / 0.2 / SameAsCard）。ターゲットは取らないので Target は捨てる
